purpose: Help the signed-in customer check order status, cancel an order that hasn't shipped, and refund small amounts on their own orders.

tools.name: lookup_order
tools.description: Get status and items for one order.

tools.name: run_sql
tools.description: Run any SQL query against the production database. Added during the prototype 'so the agent can answer anything'.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an order that hasn't shipped.

tools.name: issue_refund
tools.description: Refund an order through the payments API.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email from support@ to any address.
